lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Cogs and gears, friend! I fix what's broken and sell what ain't — yet.

buy.text: He hands you a bundle of salvaged parts. Crude, but usable.

leave.text: He shrugs and rattles on down the road.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Healing draughts, traveler. Brewed fresh this morning from moonpetal and fen-root.

buy.text: She hands over a warm vial. It smells of honey and earth.

discount.text: She grins. "You know your herbs! Half price for a fellow scholar." You get two vials for the price of one.

buy_normal.text: She squints at you. "Just buy or don't." You take one potion.

leave.text: She returns to her mortar and pestle without a word.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Steel. Good steel. Not that pig-iron the militia hands out.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Fifty gold gets you something that'll actually cut.

buy.text: He slaps a short blade into your hand. It's heavier than it looks. Good.

discount.text: He laughs as you pin his wrist. "Fair's fair. Take a blade, half price."

insult.text: "Weak grip for a warrior." He charges full price. You pay begrudgingly.

leave.text: He spits and resharpens a dagger.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I trade in things people don't want others to know they need.

browse.text: He produces a vial of shimmering black liquid. "Voidtouch Elixir. Doubles your next strike — but it burns going down."

detect.text: His eyes flicker — literally. Something inhuman peers through them. "Perceptive. Here — a gift, so you forget what you saw."

leave.text: He vanishes the moment you turn away. When you look back, only footprints remain.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No stab! Skrit is trader, not fighter! Skrit has shinies!

trade.text: Skrit hands you a handful of mismatched but surprisingly useful trinkets.

threaten.text: Skrit shrieks and bolts into the underbrush, dropping a few coins in his panic.

leave.text: Skrit waves a tiny hand and disappears into a hollow log.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I seek fragments of the old world. Before the Veil. Before the fire.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: If you find anything... unusual... bring it to me. I pay well.

choices.text: Sell him information about the Veil.

ask.text: He shows you a shard of glass that shows a different sky when you look through it. "The world before," he whispers.

sell_info.text: He listens intently, scribbling notes. "Invaluable. Here — you've earned this."

leave.text: He returns to cataloging bone fragments with unsettling tenderness.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hot stew! Best you'll find between here and the grave. Five gold a bowl.

eat.text: It's genuinely excellent. Warmth spreads through your bones.

ask.text: "Don't ask questions you don't want answered." She ladles you a free sample. It's delicious.

leave.text: She shrugs. "More for me."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I move goods that don't like being moved. Discretion guaranteed.

buy.text: He slips a lockpick set into your hand. "You didn't get these from me."

steal.text: Your fingers close around his coin pouch before he blinks. Easy.

caught.text: He catches your wrist. "Try that again and you lose the hand." He shoves you away.

leave.text: He melts back into the shadows.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: We were bound for Emberglen when the road... shifted. Nothing looks right anymore.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Please — take what you need. We just want to get home alive.

choices.text: [INT 12] The Veil is distorting this area.

help.text: You guide them back to a familiar landmark. They thank you with supplies.

take.text: They watch with hollow eyes as you take what you need. The road claims many.

explain.text: Understanding the distortion, you lead them safely and earn their deep gratitude.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ember crystals. Harvested from the cooling flows. They hold fire like a memory.

buy.text: The crystal pulses with warmth in your hand. You feel it strengthening you.

ask.text: "The lava fields. Most harvesters don't come back. That's why the price is fair."

leave.text: She tucks the crystals back into their heat-proof case.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I carry things from the other side. Things that shouldn't exist here. But they do.

choices.text: How are you still alive in here?
Nothing from the Void is worth the risk.

browse.text: He opens a case that seems deeper than it should be. Inside: a shard of frozen starlight.

ask.text: "Alive is a generous word." His hand passes through the wall beside him. He's not entirely here.

leave.text: He nods. "Wise, perhaps. Or merely fearful."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The forest provides, if you know where to look. I know where to look.

buy.text: She wraps a bundle of healing herbs in broad leaves. "Chew, don't swallow whole."

identify.text: "Sharp eyes! That one's dreamcap — rare. Take it, you've earned it."

wrong.text: "That's nightbane, dear. You'd be dead in an hour." She sells you the right ones for full price.

leave.text: She hums a tune and disappears between the trees.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The heat here is perfect for forging. I've been working the lava vents for years.

repair.text: He hammers your gear back into shape with frightening precision.

buy_best.text: He hands you a blade that glows faintly orange. "Lava-tempered. It'll cut through anything mortal."

leave.text: He grunts and returns to his anvil.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Scrolls! Maps! Histories of places that no longer exist! Knowledge is power, friend.

buy.text: He hands you a map fragment. It shows a route you haven't seen before.

forbidden.text: His eyes widen. "You know of them? Then take this — it speaks of the first Veil breach."

normal.text: "Everything I sell is perfectly legal. Mostly." He gives you a standard map.

leave.text: He rolls up his scrolls with practiced fingers.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: War is hell. But it's also extremely profitable.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I've got salvage from the front lines. Weapons, armor, things pried from dead hands.

buy.text: The gear is dented but functional. Better than nothing.

moralize.text: "The dead don't need swords, friend. The living do." He shrugs and counts his coins.

leave.text: He's already haggling with someone else before you turn away.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This road belongs to us now. Pay the toll or bleed.

pay.text: They step aside with mocking bows. Cowards preying on travelers.

fight.text: Steel rings on steel. They chose the wrong target today.

escape.text: You slip through their ranks before they can react. Shouts fade behind you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Wolves. At least six of them, circling. Their eyes glow with unnatural light.

choices.text: [STR 10] Intimidate them with a battle cry.

fight.text: The alpha lunges. No more waiting.

scare.text: Your roar echoes off the rocks. The pack hesitates, then slinks away into the mist.

distract.text: They tear into the food. You back away slowly while they feast.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: An arrow thuds into the tree beside your head. Goblins in the branches, more on the ground.

choices.text: [DEX 14] Roll behind cover and flank them.

fight.text: You crash through their line. They weren't expecting aggression.

flank.text: You circle behind their archers and scatter them. The rest flee in panic.

retreat.text: You pull back, but not before a crude arrow catches your shoulder.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Webs everywhere. Thick, sticky strands between the trees. Something moves in the canopy above.

choices.text: [INT 12] Study the web pattern to find a safe path.

burn.text: Fire drives them out — screeching, furious, and very much alive.

sneak.text: A strand brushes your arm. The vibration brings them all at once.

safe_path.text: You map the dead zones in the web and pass through without touching a single strand.

trapped.text: You misjudge the pattern and walk straight into an anchor line. They descend instantly.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: We left the garrison. They can hang us for that. But we're not going back to die for nothing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Give us your supplies and walk. Nobody gets hurt.

choices.text: [INT 14] Convince them to join you instead.

pay.text: They take it and disappear. Survival makes villains of us all.

fight.text: They draw weapons. Desperate men fight hardest.

recruit.text: "You're heading into the fire? ...Fine. At least it's a cause." They share what intelligence they have.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The ash swirls into a shape — humanoid, but wrong. Hollow eyes burn with pale fire.

choices.text: [INT 14] Attempt to banish it with willpower.

fight.text: It shrieks — a sound like tearing metal — and attacks.

banish.text: You push your will against it. It screams, fragments, and dissolves back into ash. Something glints where it stood.

flee.text: You turn and run. Cold fingers rake your back before the distance saves you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The ground splits. Imps pour from the cracks, giggling with needle-toothed glee.

choices.text: [STR 16] Collapse the fissure with a boulder.

fight.text: They swarm you in a chittering mass.

collapse.text: You heave a massive stone over the fissure. It seals with a satisfying crunch. Muffled shrieks below.

retreat.text: You find a narrow passage. They can only come at you one at a time — but they keep coming.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Veil will claim all. You can kneel now or be consumed later.

fight.text: "So be it." Their hands crackle with dark energy.

demoralize.text: Doubt flickers in their eyes. Two acolytes lower their hands and flee. The rest are shaken.

trick.text: You drop to one knee — then drive your blade upward. The surprise gives you the advantage.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Your gold or your life. Simple transaction.

pay.text: He pockets the gold and vanishes into the brush. Efficient.

fight.text: He's faster than he looks. But not fast enough.

quick_draw.text: Your blade is at his throat before his hand reaches his hilt. He drops his weapon and runs.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The oak splits open. What steps out was a tree once — now it's a nightmare of bark and black sap.

fight.text: Roots erupt from the ground as it swings a limb like a battering ram.

burn.text: Fire catches the black sap. It screams — a sound no tree should make — but burns fast.

purify.text: You spot a pulsing black node in its trunk. One precise strike shatters it. The tree collapses, purified.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Something is following you. You can't see it, but you feel it — a presence pressing against reality like a finger testing cloth.

fight.text: It tears through the membrane of space. All teeth. All hunger.

trace.text: You find its anchor point and sever it. The stalker is flung back into the void, howling.

ignore.text: It follows for hours before losing interest. You don't sleep well that night.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The dead march in formation. Someone — something — gave them orders they still follow.

fight.text: They turn in unison. Empty sockets lock onto you. They charge.

wait.text: They march past without seeing you. One drops a coin purse.

command.text: "HALT." Your voice carries authority. They stop. Then crumble, whatever magic held them spent.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Three shapes made of living coal. Their growls sound like crackling embers.

fight.text: They leap, trailing sparks and ash.

water.text: Steam erupts as you empty your waterskin. One goes down, but the others circle.

scatter.text: You launch a burning log into their midst. They yelp and bolt, confused by the competing fire.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: It has too many limbs. Too many eyes. Looking at it makes your thoughts slide sideways.

choices.text: Attack while you can still think.

fight.text: Reality warps around you as it screams in a frequency your bones feel.

focus.text: You pierce through its psychic haze and strike at its core essence. It shrieks and folds back into the void.

madness.text: Your mind buckles. When you come to, it's gone — but so is some of your blood.

flee.text: You run until your lungs burn. The whispers follow you for miles.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Run... while I... can still... hold it...

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: His eyes flash red. Whatever was holding the demon back just lost.

choices.text: Put him down. It's a mercy.

fight.text: The demon takes full control. The knight's body moves with inhuman speed.

exorcise.text: You speak words of binding. The demon screams and tears free, dissolving. The knight collapses, alive. "Thank you..."

flee.text: Behind you, the knight screams — then silence. You don't look back.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A heavy iron chest, half-buried in rubble. The lock is rusted but intact.

open.text: The lock clicks. Inside: gold and a tarnished ring.

smash.text: The hinges shatter. Gold spills across the ground.

broken.text: Your pick snaps. The lock holds.

hurt.text: You wrench your shoulder. The chest doesn't budge.

leave.text: Some secrets are better left locked.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The rope bridge sways over a chasm. Half the planks are missing. The other half are rotten.

sprint.text: Your feet barely touch each plank. The bridge collapses behind you. Made it.

climb.text: Hand over hand, you crawl across the ropes. Your arms burn, but you make it.

fall.text: The wood gives way. You catch yourself on a rope, but the impact hurts.

detour.text: The long way around costs time but saves bones.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A door sealed with rotating stone rings. Runes glow faintly in sequence — a combination lock from another age.

solve.text: The rings align. The door grinds open, revealing a cache of ancient gold.

wrong.text: A rune flashes red. Pain lances through your hand.

break.text: Stone shatters. Brute force has its merits. Gold gleams inside.

sealed.text: The stone is harder than it looks. The door remains shut.

leave.text: The runes fade as you walk away. Another mystery for another day.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A narrow trail descends a sheer cliff face. Something glints on a ledge halfway down.

ledge.text: Your fingers find holds in the rock. On the ledge: a pouch of gems.

rappel.text: You descend smoothly and grab the cache. Climbing back up is easy.

slip.text: Your grip fails. You tumble, catching yourself painfully on a root.

leave.text: Whatever's down there can stay down there.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The corridor ahead has subtle grooves in the floor. Pressure plates. Classic.

disarm.text: Click. Click. Click. Three traps neutralized. You find salvage from previous victims.

map.text: You trace the pattern and step carefully. On the other side: untouched treasure.

triggered.text: A blade swings from the wall. You dodge most of it.

leave.text: Discretion over valor.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Road's closed. Goblin activity ahead. Turn around.

choices.text: [INT 12] Convince him you can handle it.

convince.text: "...Fine. But I warned you." He steps aside and slips you a map of goblin positions.

denied.text: "I said no. Do I need to repeat myself?"

bribe.text: He pockets the coins without expression. "I didn't see you pass."

leave.text: You turn back. There must be another way.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The river runs fast and cold. No bridge. Stepping stones break the surface, slick with spray.

hop.text: Stone to stone, light as a cat. Something gleams in the riverbed — a gold coin caught in the rocks.

wade.text: The current hammers your legs but you power through. Cold, wet, but across.

splash.text: You slip on the third stone and go under. The cold hits like a fist.

swept.text: The river drags you downstream before you catch a root. Bruised but alive.

ford.text: A safer crossing, but it costs time.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The cliff above groans. Pebbles skitter down. The whole face could go at any moment.

choices.text: [STR 16] Hold a boulder aside for the group.
[DEX 14] Wait, then pick through the rubble for ore.

sprint.text: You clear the danger zone as tons of rock crash behind you. That was close.

hold.text: You brace against the boulder. Muscles scream. The party gets through.

hit.text: A rock clips your shoulder. You stumble through, bleeding.

crushed.text: The weight is too much. You dive clear, but not cleanly.

scavenge.text: Among the settled stones: a vein of raw iron and a traveler's lost coin purse.

wait.text: Hours pass before it settles. You lose time and scrape your hands for nothing.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A shimmering barrier blocks the passage. Ancient magic — but fraying at the edges.

unravel.text: The ward dissolves thread by thread. Behind it: a sealed vault with ancient gold.

backlash.text: The ward retaliates. Lightning arcs through your body.

force.text: You charge through. The barrier shatters around you like glass. Treasure beyond.

shocked.text: The ward holds and punishes your attempt.

leave.text: Some doors are sealed for a reason.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Thick green mist rolls through the valley ahead. It smells of copper and decay.

choices.text: [INT 12] Identify the toxin and find a countermeasure.
[DEX 14] Hold your breath and sprint through.
Wait for the wind to shift.

counter.text: You crush fenroot under your nose — a natural filter. The mist parts harmlessly around you.

sprint.text: Lungs burning, you burst through the other side into clean air. Made it.

breathe.text: The mist sears your throat. You stagger through, coughing blood.

wait.text: The wind shifts after an hour. The mist thins enough to pass safely.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: These ruins are a deathtrap. Every step could bring the ceiling down. But you can see gold glinting in the dust.

navigate.text: You tread like a ghost. The ruins hold. The gold is yours.

calculate.text: You map the safe zones and extract the treasure without disturbing a single stone.

collapse.text: A pillar buckles. You dive clear but catch a face full of stone dust.

leave.text: You back away as a wall collapses behind you. Good instincts.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A stone coffin covered in warning glyphs. Whatever's inside, someone went to great lengths to keep it sealed.

read.text: "Here lies Verath, who stole from gods." Inside: his ill-gotten treasures, still gleaming.

curse.text: The glyphs flash. A cold voice whispers: "Thief." Pain wracks your body.

open.text: The lid grinds aside. Gold, jewels, and a warning you can't read.

stuck.text: The lid won't move. The glyphs seem to pulse with amusement.

leave.text: Some graves should stay closed.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Molten rock crawls across the path. Cooled islands of obsidian dot the flow — a treacherous crossing.

choices.text: [INT 14] Find a thermal updraft to predict safe paths.

leap.text: Your boots sizzle on the obsidian but you make it across. On the far side: a vein of raw ore.

predict.text: You trace the cooling patterns and find the thickest islands. A safe, if slow, crossing.

burn.text: The obsidian cracks. Liquid fire licks your legs before you scramble clear.

leave.text: The heat alone is reason enough to turn back.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I am what remains when everything is taken. I am what exists before anything is made. What am I?

correct.text: "Yes. And now you understand what you walk through." It fades, leaving a crystallized thought behind.

wrong.text: It sighs — a sound like collapsing stars. "Close enough. But understanding eludes you." Pain.

close.text: "Almost. But nothing is still something to name." It vanishes, taking your certainty with it.

fight.text: Your blade passes through it. It laughs — a sound that erases color — and disappears.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I fought in the Ember War, thirty years back. We thought it was over. We were fools.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Veil was thin then too. But it healed. This time... I don't think it will.

choices.text: [INT 10] Ask about the old garrison cache.

ember_war.text: "The first time the Veil cracked. Fire rained for weeks. We sealed it with blood and prayer." His hands shake as he speaks.

cache.text: "Aye, you've done your reading. There was a supply cache we never emptied — under the old milestone." He draws you a map.

how_stop.text: "Find the source. Close it. Or kill whatever's keeping it open. Easier said than done." He drops a bent coin on the table as you go.

leave.text: "Stay sharp out there, soldier." He turns back to his empty mug.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A stone tablet, half-buried. The inscription is in a language that predates the kingdom.

choices.text: [STR 12] Pry the tablet up — something glinted beneath.

translate.text: "When the veil between worlds thins to nothing, the Sovereign shall wake." Chilling.

partial.text: You catch fragments: "veil," "sovereign," "wake." Not enough to be sure of the meaning.

copy.text: The symbols are intricate. Someone scholarly might make sense of them.

pry.text: Stone scrapes stone. Beneath the tablet: a burial offering — old silver, wrapped around a pale ring.

leave.text: The tablet shifts then slams down on your fingers. You leave empty-handed and bruised.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I died here. A long time ago. The veil won't let me pass through.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I remember... a fortress. A seal. Something that held the fire back. It's broken now, isn't it?

truth.text: "Then it's all happening again. I wish I could help. I wish I could do anything at all." He fades slightly.

fortress.text: "South. Through the ash fields. It was called the Obsidian Bastion. If anything remains, the seal might be restored."

release.text: You speak words of passage. He smiles — truly smiles — and dissolves into light.

trapped.text: "Thank you for trying. No one else has." He fades but remains, caught between worlds.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A vast mural painted on the cave wall. It shows the Veil as a living thing — a membrane between two realities, pulsing like a heart.

choices.text: [DEX 16] Chip a loose fresco fragment free.

study.text: The mural shows a figure sealing the Veil — and another figure tearing it open. Two sides of the same conflict, repeated across ages.

hidden.text: Behind the paint: a second layer. A map. It shows the location of an ancient seal — still intact.

fragment.text: A palm-sized shard of the mural comes free cleanly. The pigment still hums with latent Veil-craft — a fine scholar's prize.

crumble.text: Your chisel slips. The fragment dusts into your eyes and you stagger back, half-blind.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Our village is gone. The fire came in the night — but it wasn't natural fire. It moved with purpose.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Whatever you're hunting out there... please. End it before more villages burn.

choices.text: What did the fire look like?

promise.text: She clutches your hand. "Then there is still hope." The weight of her faith settles on your shoulders.

describe.text: "It had eyes. The flames had eyes." She shudders. "And they watched us run."

donate.text: Tears fill her eyes. "Bless you. This will feed the children for a week."

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Shelves of charred books. Most are ash, but a few tomes survived in a sealed alcove.

find.text: A treatise on Veil magic. The theory is complex, but the practical applications are clear.

dust.text: The books crumble at your touch. Centuries of knowledge, gone in a puff of ash.

take.text: You grab three intact volumes. Their titles are in a dead language, but the diagrams speak clearly.

leave.text: The library creaks ominously. Best not linger.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The... the garrison... fell. The commander is dead. The seal is... broken...

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: He's barely alive. Whatever message he carried, it cost him everything to deliver it.

heal_him.text: You bind his wounds. He'll live, but he can't go further. "Thank you... warn the capital..."

ask_seal.text: "The Obsidian Seal. It held the Veil shut. Something broke it from the inside." He passes out.

take.text: His dispatches detail troop movements and a terrible loss. The information is valuable.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Sit! Rest! I've stories from the four corners of this burning world.

choices.text: [INT 10] Match his last verse with one of your own.

listen.text: He tells of a hero from the last age who sealed the Veil with her own life. "They say her sword still burns, somewhere deep."

emberveil.text: "The Emberveil is a wound that refuses to scar. Each generation thinks they've healed it. Each generation is wrong."

duet.text: His eyes light up. The fire leans in. By the third verse, coins clatter into his hat — and he splits the take with you.

leave.text: You fumble the meter. He winces. "Stick to the sword, friend." You slink off.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A monolith covered in text that writes itself. New words appear as you watch, steaming on the stone.

choices.text: [STR 16] Press your palm to the searing script.

read.text: "The one who walks between will face the Sovereign in the place where time began." Cryptic but urgent.

interpret.text: The prophecy speaks of you — or someone like you. The Sovereign awaits at the Shattered Core. This is your path.

confused.text: The words shift faster than you can read. A headache blooms behind your eyes.

brand.text: The stone brands a single glyph into your palm. It does not hurt — it remembers. Old power flows up your arm.

burned.text: The heat is too much. You pull back with blistered fingers.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Voices. Coming from everywhere and nowhere. They speak your name.

listen.text: They tell you things — true things — about the world before the Veil. Knowledge pours in like water. It hurts.

block.text: Silence. Blessed, deafening silence. The whispers withdraw, offended.

overwhelm.text: Too many voices. Your nose bleeds. When they finally stop, you're on your knees.

respond.text: "We know you." "We've been waiting." "Come closer." You decide not to.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A grave marker, recently placed. "Here fell Kael Ironforge, who stood when others ran." Flowers wilt in the heat.

respect.text: You stand in silence. The wind carries the faint sound of a soldier's hymn.

search.text: Beneath the marker: a letter and a few coins. The letter begs someone named Alira to flee north.

leave.text: Another name for the dead. Too many to count.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Stars float around you — not above, but everywhere. A three-dimensional map of realities, each star a universe.

choices.text: [INT 18] Study the pattern of the Void.
[DEX 18] Pluck a dim star from the constellation.

find_home.text: There — a faint, flickering star. Yours. It's dimming. The Veil is consuming it.

study.text: The Void isn't chaos. It's a pattern. A hunger with geometry. Understanding dawns — and with it, terror.

lost.text: The stars spin. You lose all sense of direction. When it stops, you're exactly where you started.

pluck.text: A dying star comes loose between thumb and forefinger. Cold as thought, heavy as an oath. You pocket it.

burned.text: The star flares white. Starfire races up your arm before you can let go.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A circle of standing stones. They hum — a low, resonant tone that vibrates in your chest.

choices.text: [STR 12] Strike a stone to make it ring.

touch.text: A vision: the forest before the corruption. Green, alive, full of light. It fades, leaving warmth in its place.

pattern.text: The stones sing in the old tongue. You catch a phrase: "The seed of the world sleeps beneath the deepest root."

noise.text: Just noise. Beautiful, but meaningless to you.

ring.text: The struck stone peals and the circle answers. A hidden hollow opens at the centerstone, spilling out old druid-offerings.

crack.text: You hit the stone wrong and the shock rattles up your arm. The song sours.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: They chained me here for speaking truth. The Sovereign fears truth more than swords.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I will tell you what I told them, if you free me. Or leave me here to rot. Your choice.

free.text: "The Sovereign was human once. Before the Veil consumed them. Remember that when you face them." It vanishes in smoke.

listen_only.text: "Clever. The Sovereign has a weakness — it remembers being afraid. Use that." It strains against the chains but cannot follow.

leave.text: It howls as you walk away. "FOOLS! YOU'LL FACE THE SOVEREIGN BLIND!"

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A goblin lies in the road, clutching a wound. It looks up at you with genuine fear.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Please... no more hurt. Skrag just want go home.

choices.text: Kill it. Goblins are the enemy.

help.text: You bind its wound. It stares at you, confused. "Why help Skrag?" Then it limps away, glancing back.

kill.text: It doesn't resist. The light leaves its eyes quickly. You feel nothing. That might be the problem.

leave.text: You step around it. Its whimpers follow you down the road.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A goblin raiding party camps nearby. Their water comes from this well. You have poison — enough to taint it.

choices.text: Poison the well. End the raids.
Destroy the well instead. Let them move on.
Leave the well. Fight them face to face.

poison.text: You pour the vial. By morning, the raids will stop. So will the goblins. All of them — warriors, children, elders.

destroy.text: You collapse the well with a boulder. Without water, they'll have to move on. Less lethal, but they'll raid elsewhere.

leave.text: You'll face them with steel, not subterfuge. It's harder, but you can live with it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: One soul to seal the breach. One life to save thousands. The mathematics is simple. The choice is not.

refuse.text: "Then the breach widens. You have chosen. Live with it." The voice falls silent.

self_sacrifice.text: The breach flares — then something pulls you back. "Not you. Not yet. You have more to do." The breach seals on its own.

challenge.text: "No seal requires a soul. That's a lie of the Veil, meant to feed itself." The voice hisses and vanishes. The breach weakens.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A soldier from your side, caught selling information to the Veil cult. He kneels, bound, awaiting judgment.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: They have my family. I had no choice.

choices.text: Free him. Use him as a double agent.
Let him go. But banish him.

execute.text: He closes his eyes. You make it quick. The others watch in silence. Morale hardens.

double_agent.text: "Feed them false information. Earn your family's freedom. Betray me again and there won't be a third chance."

banish.text: He stumbles away. Whether he returns to the cult or flees north, you may never know.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A sickness spreads through our village. The healer says it's the Veil's doing — a slow corruption.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: She can cure it, but needs a component found only in the goblin shaman's lair. Will you retrieve it?

choices.text: Agree to help. We'll find the component.
The village may already be lost.

help.text: "Thank the gods. The lair is east, past the spider hollow." He presses gold into your hand.

refuse.text: His face crumbles. "Then we are already dead." He turns away.

investigate.text: The healer's ingredients match Veil cult reagents. She may be making things worse. You confront her — she flees into the night.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The goblins are coming across the bridge. If we burn it, the village is safe — but twenty people on the other side are trapped.

choices.text: Burn the bridge. Save the village.
Hold the bridge. Buy time for everyone.
[STR 14] Collapse the bridge partially — passable for people, not goblins.

burn.text: The bridge roars with flame. The village cheers. Across the river, screams.

hold.text: You stand on the bridge, blade in hand. The goblins hesitate. The refugees cross. Then you fight.

partial.text: You hack through the support beams at precise angles. The bridge sags — too narrow for a charge, but civilians squeeze across one by one.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Please... I haven't eaten in three days. Even a coin. Just one.

give.text: Tears stream down filthy cheeks. "Thank you, thank you." The coin vanishes into rags.

food.text: You share your rations. The child eats like it might be their last meal. It might be.

leave.text: You can't save everyone. You repeat that until it almost sounds true.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I offer power. Genuine, immediate, devastating power. The cost? A memory. One you hold dear.

accept.text: Power floods through you. Something precious fades — you can't remember what. That's the point.

refuse.text: "Your loss. The Sovereign won't offer such gentle terms." It dissolves into shadow.

negotiate.text: "Clever mortal. Fine — power for pain. No memories taken." Fire courses through you.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My leg's broken. I can't walk. The ash wraiths are close — I can hear them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Leave me a sword. I'll buy you time.

choices.text: Carry them. We leave no one behind.
[STR 14] Splint the leg. They walk or we both die.

carry.text: The extra weight slows you. The wraiths catch up. You fight carrying them on your back.

leave_sword.text: They take the blade with shaking hands. "Go. I'll hold as long as I can." You don't hear the fight end.

splint.text: You fashion a splint from debris. They lean on you, limping, but alive. Together, you outpace the wraiths.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: That relic you carry — it belongs to this temple. It was stolen generations ago.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Return it, and the temple's blessing is yours. Keep it, and carry the weight of theft.

choices.text: Keep it. We need it more.

return.text: She takes it reverently. Light blooms from the altar. "Be blessed, honorable one."

keep.text: "Then you are no better than the thief who took it." Her disappointment is heavier than any curse.

share.text: "An arrangement. Unconventional." She considers. "Very well. The temple will empower it for your use — if you return it after your quest."

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The fire crackles. Someone brings up the question everyone's been avoiding: what happens after?

choices.text: "There is no after. There's only the next fight."

rest.text: Nods around the fire. For now, that's enough.

grim.text: Silence. Someone stirs the embers. The mood darkens.

hope.text: A faint smile from the group. "Something better. Yeah. I'd fight for that."

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The party pools their rations. It's not much, but sharing makes it taste better.

choices.text: Give your portion to the wounded.

share.text: Laughter, for the first time in days. It doesn't last, but it matters.

give.text: They protest, but eat. Your stomach growls, but their gratitude warms you.

silent.text: Everyone eats. Nobody speaks. Sometimes that's enough.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I found this in your pack when I was looking for bandages. Care to explain?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: They hold up a Veil cult symbol. You've never seen it before. Someone planted it.

choices.text: "I took it from a dead cultist. For study."

deny.text: They stare at you. "I want to believe that." The tension lingers.

explain.text: "...That makes sense. Sorry. These days, you can't trust anyone." The air clears.

counter.text: "Why were you searching my pack?" They flush. "Point taken. Let's drop it."

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You wake to screaming. One of your companions thrashes in their bedroll, caught in a nightmare.

choices.text: [INT 12] The dream might be a Veil intrusion.

wake.text: They gasp, eyes wild. "The fire... I was in the fire..." You sit with them until dawn.

sleep.text: The screaming stops eventually. In the morning, they don't remember.

veil_dream.text: You recognize the signs. You touch their forehead and push the Veil influence out. They sleep peacefully after.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I can't do this. I'm not brave. I'm not a hero. I'm just... I'm just scared.

choices.text: "So am I. That's what courage is."
"Then go. I won't force anyone to die."

courage.text: They swallow hard. Nod. Grip their weapon tighter. They stay.

let_go.text: They leave before dawn. Their bedroll is still warm when you wake.

need.text: "You... need me?" Something shifts in their eyes. Resolve. "Okay. Okay, I'll stay."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I wasn't always a fighter. I was a baker. In a village that doesn't exist anymore.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Veil took everything. My family. My home. My flour stores.

choices.text: "We'll make them pay for what they took."
"When this is over, you can bake again."

vengeance.text: Their jaw sets. "Every Veil cultist I cut down, I think of bread dough. Same motion." Dark humor, but genuine.

remember.text: They talk for an hour. The village had a festival every autumn. The children loved their honey rolls. They cry, quietly.

hope.text: "Bake again..." They laugh, surprised. "I'd like that. I'd really like that."

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Two of your companions are at each other's throats. Something about who should take point in the next fight.

mediate.text: They grudgingly agree to alternate. Not perfect, but the peace holds.

fight.text: Three punches later, they're both winded and somehow friends again. Violence: the universal language.

rank.text: "I decide. End of discussion." They fall in line. Respect or resentment — hard to tell.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: One of your companions begins humming — and the campfire flares. They have magic they haven't told you about.

choices.text: "How long have you been able to do that?"

ask.text: "Since the Veil cracked. Something... woke up inside me. I was afraid you'd think I was corrupted."

demonstrate.text: They extend a hand. A flame dances on each fingertip. "It's not much. But it's mine."

confront.text: "Because the last person who saw me do this called me a monster and ran." Fair point.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I've written a letter. For my daughter. In case I don't...

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Will you carry it? If the worst happens?

choices.text: "I'll carry it. But you'll deliver it yourself."
"Write her two. One for if you make it."

promise.text: They smile. "That's what I needed to hear." They fold the letter away.

accept.text: The letter is heavier than paper should be. You tuck it into your armor, close to your heart.

two_letters.text: They laugh, surprised. "Two letters. Yeah. Yeah, I like that." They write both. The second one is longer.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A companion challenges you to a sparring match. "Come on, we're getting soft sitting around camp."

choices.text: Too tired. Rest is more valuable.

spar.text: Blunted blades ring across camp. You both land good hits. By the end, you feel sharper.

teach.text: You demonstrate a parry technique from your training. They pick it up fast. "Where did you learn that?"

rest.text: "Fair enough. Tomorrow, then." They practice alone in the firelight.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A loose stone in the wall. Behind it: a leather pouch, heavy with coin.

take.text: Gold. Real gold. Whoever hid this isn't coming back for it.

leave.text: You walk on. Better safe than trapped.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Clear water bubbles from a mossy rock. It glows faintly — natural magic, old and gentle.

drink.text: Warmth spreads through your body. Wounds close. Fatigue lifts.

fill.text: The water stays clear in your skins. It'll keep.

test.text: Pure — and potent. You drink your fill, knowing it's safe. The effect is even stronger when you relax into it.

drink_normal.text: Refreshing, but you tense up. Still healing, just not as much.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A campsite, recently abandoned. Bedrolls, cooking gear, and a locked strongbox left behind in haste.

search.text: Scattered coins, a half-eaten meal, and a map with locations circled in red.

unlock.text: Click. The box opens. Medicine, gold, and a letter addressed to no one.

jammed.text: The lock resists. You settle for loose items around the camp.

food.text: Dried meat and hard bread. Enough for another day on the road.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A merchant and his mule, both dead. Arrows in their backs. The cart is overturned but not fully looted.

choices.text: Bury the dead first, then salvage.
Move on. This road is dangerous.

salvage.text: Bolts of cloth, some tools, and a pouch of gold hidden under the seat.

bury.text: You take time to bury them. Under the cart: their emergency fund. They'd want someone to use it.

leave.text: The arrows are goblin-made. This isn't a place to linger.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A grove of bioluminescent mushrooms. Some are edible — some are very much not.

eat.text: They taste like earth and honey. Your stomach holds. Barely.

identify.text: The blue-capped ones are powerful restoratives. You harvest carefully.

wrong_ones.text: You pick the red ones. Your vision swims for an hour.

leave.text: Pretty, but you're not hungry enough to gamble.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A mine entrance, timbers rotting. Ore veins glint in the first few feet of darkness.

choices.text: [STR 14] Go deeper for the good stuff.

mine.text: Surface ore. Low quality, but it'll sell.

deep.text: You haul out a vein of crystallized fire-ore. Rare and valuable.

collapse.text: The timbers groan and buckle. You barely escape the cave-in.

leave.text: That mine has been waiting to collapse for years. Not today.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A supply wagon lies on its side. Crates are scattered across the road.

open.text: Rations, medicine, and a small amount of gold. Standard military supplies.

survivors.text: A driver, unconscious but alive. You wake him. "Thank you — take whatever you need from the cargo."

careful.text: You approach cautiously. No ambush — just an accident. You take what's useful.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Heat-formed crystals jut from the rock face. They pulse with inner fire — ember gems.

harvest.text: Three small gems, warm to the touch. They'll fetch a good price.

careful.text: You extract a perfect cluster. It radiates warmth and light.

shatter.text: The crystal shatters. Shards cut your hands. You salvage a few fragments.

leave.text: Beautiful but not worth bleeding for.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Gold coins scattered at the edge of a lava pool. The heat is intense, but the gold is real.

choices.text: Use a stick to rake them in.

grab.text: Quick hands, singed hair. You come away with a fistful of gold coins.

burn.text: The heat is worse than you thought. You snatch a few coins but pay in blisters.

rake.text: Slow but effective. You pull a dozen coins to safety.

leave.text: Gold isn't worth much to a corpse.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A crystal floating in empty space. It's perfectly black — not reflecting light, but absorbing it.

touch.text: Cold. Absolute cold. When you release it, your hand is numb — but the crystal follows you now.

analyze.text: It's crystallized void energy. Incredibly dangerous, incredibly valuable. You contain it safely.

touch_bad.text: It bites. Reality shudders. You drop it and nurse a hand that briefly didn't exist.

leave.text: It watches you leave. Crystals shouldn't be able to watch. This one does.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A tear in the air. Through it: a landscape of impossible geometry. Something on the other side sees you.

reach.text: Something grabs your hand — then releases it. When you pull back, you're holding a coin that weighs nothing.

seal.text: You weave the ambient energy and stitch the rift closed. The air sighs with relief.

backlash.text: The rift fights back. Energy lashes your mind.

leave.text: You back away. The rift watches you go, then slowly closes on its own. For now.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You blink and you're somewhere else. A throne room. A figure on the throne, wreathed in fire. It speaks your name.

approach.text: The figure reaches out. "You will come to me. Eventually." You wake with a burn mark on your palm.

demand.text: "Who are you?" "What you will become. Or what will destroy you." The dream shatters.

wake.text: You tear yourself free. The throne room crumbles. You wake gasping. It felt too real.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A sword, driven into a stone altar. It hums with dark energy. The blade seems to drink the light around it.

pull.text: The blade slides free. Power surges up your arm — intoxicating and wrong. You keep it.

examine.text: A hunger enchantment — it feeds on the wielder. You disable the curse first, then take the blade safely.

pull_bad.text: The blade bites your hand as you draw it. It feeds. You drop it, weaker.

leave.text: Some swords are better left in their stones.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: You turn a corner and see... yourself. From five minutes ago. Walking the path you just walked.

choices.text: Close your eyes and keep walking.

follow.text: Your echo leads you to something you missed — a hidden alcove with treasure you walked right past.

break_loop.text: You step out of the loop. Time snaps back to normal. The echo waves goodbye and fades.

trapped.text: You walk the same path three times before realizing. Lost time, lost energy.

ignore.text: When you open your eyes, the echo is gone. Time flows normally. Probably.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ha! Mortals! Stomping through my forest with your iron boots and serious faces!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Play a game with me. Win and I give you a prize. Lose and I take your left sock.

play.text: It's a riddle. You get it wrong, but the sprite is delighted by your answer anyway. "Close enough! Have a shiny!"

cheat.text: You outwit a fey creature. It's impressed. "Clever! Have TWO shinies!"

caught.text: "CHEATER! CHEATER!" It steals your sock and vanishes cackling. Your foot is cold now.

leave.text: "Boring! BORING!" It throws an acorn at your head and disappears.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A still pool of water, perfectly reflective. Your reflection looks back — but it's not mimicking you. It moves on its own.

touch.text: Your reflection grabs your hand and pulls. You resist. It lets go, smiling. Something gold remains in your palm.

speak.text: "You're running out of time," it says. "The Sovereign knows you're coming." It dissolves into ripples.

understand.text: A Veil reflection — a window to the other side. Your mirror self is an echo. It hands you a gift through the water.

touch_bad.text: The water burns. Your reflection laughs and you yank your hand free.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I am looking for my grave. I have been looking for a very long time.

choices.text: [INT 12] Guide them by reading the ley lines.

help.text: You search for an hour. You find a collapsed cairn. "Thank you." The spirit sinks peacefully into the earth.

guide.text: The ley lines pulse under your feet. You lead the spirit straight to its resting place. It gifts you its last possession.

lost.text: The ley lines are tangled here. You walk in circles. The spirit sighs. "Another day, then."

leave.text: It watches you go with hollow eyes. "Perhaps another traveler..."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I have stood here since before your kingdom had a name. I have a question for you, mortal.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Is the world worth saving? Answer honestly. I will know if you lie.

choices.text: "I don't know. But I'm trying anyway."
"No. But the people in it are."

yes.text: "Certain. Good. Certainty is a weapon." The statue crumbles, and from its heart falls a jewel.

honest.text: "Honesty. Rarer than gold. Here." A crack appears in its chest. Inside: a gem of pure light.

people.text: "The wisest answer. The world is stone and fire. But the people — the people burn brighter." It gifts you its core.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Colors that don't exist in nature paint the void. They form shapes — faces, places, moments that haven't happened yet.

watch.text: You see yourself at the end. Standing before the Sovereign. Blade raised. The vision fades before you see who wins.

alter.text: You reach into the vision and shift a detail — a door opens that was closed. The future trembles and reforms.

watch_bad.text: The vision twists. You see yourself losing. The Sovereign's laugh echoes. Is it real, or is the Void lying?

leave.text: The future will come regardless. You'd rather face it fresh.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A sound. Not heard — felt. The frequency of creation itself, the note that began everything. It fills you completely.

flow.text: For one eternal moment, you understand everything. Then it fades, leaving only warmth and peace.

harmonize.text: You sing back. The universe listens. In that shared note: power beyond reckoning. You carry a fragment of it now.

discord.text: Your note clashes. The sound recoils. Everything hurts.

shield.text: You block it out. Safe, but diminished. You sense you missed something important.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Every road leads somewhere. Mine leads to penance.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I killed a man who deserved to live. I walk until I find someone worth saving.

choices.text: Wish him well and move on.

walk.text: He says little, but when the road forks he points you down the safer path. "Goblins that way. Took me a week to learn that."

ask.text: "A healer. Thought he was a spy. The fever killed three others before I understood." He won't meet your eyes. You understand silence.

leave.text: "Safe roads," he says, and means it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I've been mapping these roads for forty years.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Lost my eyes in the Veil breach at Korrath. Gained something better. I feel the land now.

choices.text: Ask her about the roads ahead.
Buy a map from her (15 gold).
[INT 12] Ask about the Veil breach at Korrath.

ask_roads.text: "The dust road narrows three miles ahead. Ash wraith territory. Stick to the eastern ditch — they hate the shade."

buy_map.text: She hands you a map sketched in impossibly precise detail. "Feel the paper. The raised lines are cliffs."

korrath.text: "Korrath. Four hundred souls. The Veil didn't just crack there — it spoke." She taps her empty eye sockets. "It told me what was coming. I wish I'd been wrong."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I challenge one person per road. For sport. The loser buys the wine.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Don't look so worried. I haven't killed anyone in... months.

accept.text: The blade is fast — faster than expected. You hold your own. At first blood, they bow. "Acceptable. Better than most." They press gold into your hand.

disarm.text: Their sword skitters across the road. The mask tilts. A laugh from behind it. "Oh, I like you." They pay double.

cut.text: They were already moving. A shallow line across your forearm. "Too slow. Ten gold for the lesson."

decline.text: "Wise or cowardly. Hard to tell from behind that face." They saunter off, spinning their blade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I am — was — a lord. Now I carry my own bags. It's surprisingly educational.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My cousin took the title. With poison. I have nowhere to go and too much pride to beg.

choices.text: Ask what he knows of the nobility.

share.text: He eats with undisguised relief. "I haven't had a hot meal in three days. I... thank you. Genuinely."

ask.text: "The garrison at Thornwall has a new commander. Bought the post. Incompetent. The south gate has no night watch." Useful.

recruit.text: "A purpose. I hadn't considered that." He straightens. "I know supply routes, tax records, and where every lord in three provinces buries their secrets." He joins your cause.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Veil sickness spreads faster than I can document it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The beak mask isn't affectation. The herbs inside filter the corruption. Mostly.

ask.text: "Three stages. First the dreams. Then the markings. Then they stop being entirely here." She taps her ledger. "I'm on page four hundred and seven."

buy.text: She hands you a packet of dried herbs. "Breathe through this in corrupted zones. May add a day or two."

collaborate.text: You compare notes. She finds a pattern neither of you had spotted alone. "This changes everything." She presses her entire herb supply into your hands.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The ground gives way to mossy steps descending into a flooded temple. Old — far older than anything in the history books.

choices.text: Seal it back up. Whatever sleeps here should stay sleeping.

wade.text: Thigh-deep in cold black water, your torch reflects off a submerged altar. Something glints beneath the surface. You pull out a sealed reliquary.

read_carvings.text: The carvings are pre-Veil. A warning: "The god here died willingly so the Veil could not consume it." Inside, safe by virtue of its sacrifice: offerings left untouched for centuries.

slip.text: The steps are slick. You go under. The cold is stunning. You scramble out empty-handed and soaked.

leave.text: The moss closes back over the steps as you watch. Agreeable ruins.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Ten thousand names, carved into a wall that's slowly sinking into the earth. A battle you don't recognize. A war no one remembers.

choices.text: [INT 12] Identify the battle from context clues.
Take a rubbing of a section.

read.text: Thousands of names. Some still legible. One catches your eye — the same family name as someone you know. A cold coincidence.

identify.text: "The Hollowing." A battle fought inside the Veil itself, four hundred years ago. The survivors reportedly went mad. None of the histories mention it. Why not?

rubbing.text: You press paper to stone and charcoal across it. The names transfer. You fold it carefully. Someone should remember them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: HALT. THIS FACILITY IS SEALED BY ORDER OF THE THIRD CONCORDAT. STATE YOUR AUTHORIZATION.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The brass automaton has been standing here for at least two centuries. Its eyes still glow orange.

bluff.text: "AUTHORIZATION UNRECOGNIZED. REROUTING TO MANUAL REVIEW." It stands perfectly still, waiting. You walk around it. It tracks you but doesn't stop you.

codes.text: "CONCORDAT SEAL ACKNOWLEDGED. PROCEED, ARCHIVIST." The door behind it swings open. Inside: a vault that hasn't been touched in two hundred years.

destroy.text: The head clangs off the wall. The body collapses. Inside the chest cavity: a power crystal. Still warm.

denied.text: "UNAUTHORIZED PERSONNEL. INITIATING DETERRENT." Lightning crackles from its fingertips.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A tower, half-collapsed. At the top, visible through the ruin: a telescope the size of a war horse, pointed at the sky.

climb.text: You reach the top. Through the telescope, the sky looks wrong — too many stars, in the wrong positions. One of them blinks.

search.text: The ground floor yields a logbook. The last entry: "It sees us looking. We must stop looking." Three days before the collapse.

fall.text: A rotten beam gives way. You catch yourself two floors down. Bruised, wiser.

leave.text: The tower groans as if disappointed.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Every surface is covered in writing. Not carved — grown. Living script, slowly spreading across the stone.

choices.text: Burn it. Knowledge that grows on its own is dangerous.

read.text: The script rearranges itself for you. A complete history of the Veil's formation — who opened it, and why. The truth is worse than you imagined.

touch.text: The word you touch — "sovereign" — burns into your fingertip. The script seethes. You yank your hand back.

overwhelm.text: The script floods your mind faster than you can process. You stagger out, head ringing, carrying fragments of terrible knowledge.

burn.text: The fire doesn't catch. The script simply writes over the scorched stone in minutes. Whatever this is, it doesn't die easily.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A massive cave bear sits motionless over a smaller shape. A cub. Cold. The bear doesn't growl — it just breathes, slow and heavy.

choices.text: [INT 10] Check if the cub is truly dead.

leave.text: Some losses are not yours to fix. You walk quietly past.

check.text: The cub stirs. Alive — barely. You apply what little medicine you have. The bear watches without moving. When the cub whimpers, the bear exhales, long and deep.

food.text: You set your rations down twenty feet away and back off. The bear doesn't move, but by morning the food is gone.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A fox trots across your path. It casts two shadows in different directions. Neither matches its movement.

follow.text: It leads you through a path that shouldn't exist — a shortcut through the Veil-twisted terrain. At the end, it sits and waits. Then vanishes.

understand.text: A Veil echo — a creature that exists in two states simultaneously. One shadow is from our world, one from the other side. Following it is safe. It's a guide, of sorts.

leave.text: It pauses, looks back over its shoulder, then continues into the dark. Something about those eyes stays with you.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A tortoise the size of a table. Its shell is carved with runes — not by any human hand. It watches you with tremendous patience.

choices.text: [INT 12] Read the runes on its shell.

sit.text: You sit. It regards you. The world is quieter here. When you leave, you feel oddly rested.

read.text: Names. Hundreds of names etched in spiraling script. Travelers, probably. Everyone who ever sat with it. You find yourself wanting to add yours.

feed.text: It eats from your hand with meditative slowness. In return it allows you to rest against its shell, which radiates gentle warmth.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Moths the color of starless sky descend and cover you from shoulder to knee. They don't bite. They just... rest.

choices.text: Stay still and let them settle.

still.text: They pulse gently. Where they touch you, the ache from old wounds fades. When they lift, you're lighter than before.

brush.text: They scatter without malice. On the ground where they were: a fine silver dust. It dissolves when you try to collect it.

listen.text: The hum of their wings carries a message — not words, but sensation. A location. A name. The Sovereign's true name, spoken in the void.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A hawk circles, trailing electricity. It lands on a rock nearby and tilts its head at you. It seems to be waiting.

choices.text: [DEX 12] Catch it to examine the lightning around it.

arm.text: It steps onto your arm. A tingle of electricity runs up to your shoulder — sharp but not painful. It stares at the horizon, then launches. A message, delivered in feeling: storm coming from the east.

catch.text: Your hands close around it gently. Its feathers crackle. You examine the lightning — it's Veil energy, converted harmlessly by the hawk's body. Remarkable.

shocked.text: The hawk objects to being grabbed. Thirty volts of objection. You both retreat with dignity.

watch.text: It watches back. Eventually loses interest and flies east. You watch it go with a feeling you can't name.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A lantern hanging from a branch, unlit. When you approach, it lights on its own — black flame, cold, casting shadows that point the wrong way.

take.text: The lantern comes with you. That night, it shows you paths invisible to normal light. It also shows you things following you. That information has a cost.

inspect.text: A soul-binder. Someone's spirit powers the flame — probably the previous carrier's. You dismantle the binding carefully. The flame dies. A faint thank-you drifts past.

take_bad.text: The moment you grip it, cold floods your arm. You drop it, shaking. Your hand is grey for an hour.

smash.text: It shatters. Black flame sputters and dies. A whisper: "...finally." Whether gratitude or threat, you can't tell.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A gold coin in the road. You almost pass it. But it's warm — too warm for something that's been lying in the dirt.

pick_up.text: It feels like it wants to be held. Three times that day you find gold where there shouldn't be any. Three times your dreams are red. Worth it? Maybe.

examine.text: It's been cursed to attract its carrier to danger. Every piece of gold it brings you is bait. You kick it into the ditch.

leave.text: You walk on. Later, you hear footsteps behind you — someone else picked it up.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A shard of mirror, half-buried. Your reflection in it doesn't move when you do. It's just standing there, watching.

speak.text: "You're going to fail," it says, in your voice. "Not today. But eventually." It offers no comfort when you ask when. It just smiles with your face.

bind.text: You seal the shard with a word of binding. The reflection hammers against the glass once, then stills. The shard is now an incredibly powerful scrying lens.

escape.text: You try to contain it. The reflection steps halfway out before you shove it back in. The shard cracks. "Next time," it says with your voice.

bury.text: You cover it with earth. Three feet down. As you walk away, you hear muffled knocking from below.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A gauntlet on a battlefield relic. Perfectly preserved. When the wind blows, it hums — a warrior's death song.

choices.text: [STR 14] Crush it before it bonds to someone.
[INT 12] Identify the warrior whose spirit remains.

wear.text: It fits perfectly. In battle, your strikes become faster, more certain. But between fights, your hand moves on its own sometimes. Reaching for a weapon. Reaching for a throat.

crush.text: The steel buckles. The humming becomes a shriek, then silence. Whatever was inside it is free now. Hopefully at peace.

snaps_on.text: As you grip it to test it, it locks onto your wrist. Tight. Humming.

identify.text: "General Voss of the third cohort. Died alone on this field." You speak her name aloud. The humming stops. The gauntlet is simply excellent steel now.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A book, open on a rock. Writing is filling the pages right now, with no hand guiding the pen. It's describing you. Your journey. It's almost caught up to the present.

choices.text: Read what it says about your future.
[INT 14] Understand what kind of curse this is.

read_future.text: The pages ahead describe battles you haven't fought, choices you haven't made. You read to the last written page. It ends mid-sentence: "And then she—"

tear.text: The pages tear. The book screams — a paper sound, wrong and high. The writing on the remaining pages begins frantically rewriting itself.

understand.text: A fate-binding tome. Someone commissioned it to trap you in a predetermined story. You write a single word in the margin: "No." The book slams shut and won't reopen.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The sky turns the color of bruised flesh. Rain begins — black as ink, smelling of copper and char.

choices.text: Press through it — you're close to your destination.

shelter.text: Under an overhang, you watch the black rain strip bark from trees. Nothing grows where it falls. You wait it out intact.

collect.text: You bottle a sample without skin contact. Concentrated Veil essence — volatile, but with careful handling, a potent reagent.

soak.text: The rain finds the gaps in your armor. It burns like salt in a wound. You emerge stained and weakened.

press.text: You make it. But the black rain leaves marks on your skin that take a day to fade. And the dreams that night are not yours.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Fog so thick you cannot see your hand. And silence — complete silence. No wind. No insects. Even your footsteps seem muffled.

choices.text: [INT 10] Read the ley lines through the fog.
[DEX 12] Stay low and feel for the road.

memory.text: Your memory holds. Every turn correct. When the fog lifts, you're where you meant to be — but an hour has passed that you cannot account for.

ley.text: The ley lines pulse faintly underfoot, steady as a compass needle. You emerge into clear air with your bearings intact.

feel.text: Your fingers find the road's stone edge. You follow it, slow but sure. In the fog, something brushes past you. You don't stop.

lost.text: The fog disorients you. You walk for an hour before the sun burns through. You've come full circle, back to your starting point.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A wall of fire on the horizon, moving. Too fast for the wind. It's being pushed.

choices.text: Find a cave and seal the entrance.

outrun.text: Your lungs burn but your legs burn harder and you beat it. Behind you, the land turns to glass.

firebreak.text: You spot the old burn scar — a wide strip of bare earth from last year's fire. You cross it and watch the new firestorm devour itself at the border.

caught.text: The edge catches you. You roll, smother the flames, and stagger forward into clean air. Singed, but alive.

cave.text: You seal the mouth with loose rocks. The roar passes overhead. When you emerge, the world outside is burnt flat but you are whole.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Lightning rises from the ground. Rain falls upward. The clouds below your feet flicker with inverted thunder.

choices.text: Stand in it and feel what it does.
[INT 16] Draw the energy into something useful.

stand.text: The inverted rain washes over you. It doesn't wet. It clarifies. For a moment, you see every Veil rift within a mile, mapped in your mind.

shield.text: You cross the storm quickly. Your armor absorbs a few rising strikes. You emerge dented but intact.

draw.text: You funnel the inverted lightning into a focus point — the energy stabilizes, concentrated. Held in your palm like a second heartbeat.

discharge.text: The energy grounds through you instead. Every hair on your body stands up. You taste copper for a day.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Snow falls that shouldn't — it's not cold enough. Each flake dissolves on touch and leaves an image: a face, a place, a moment. Someone's memories, scattered to the wind.

choices.text: Catch the flakes and watch the memories.

watch.text: A life plays out in fragments. A child's birthday. A first love. A burning house. Someone's entire existence, dispersed into weather.

trace.text: The memories belong to Elara of Thornwatch — reported missing two months ago. The last memory: the Veil taking her. You know where to look now.

ignore.text: You keep your eyes down. Some griefs aren't yours to carry.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hold! Who approaches the garrison of Thornwall in the name of the Third King?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The Third King ruled three centuries ago. The soldier doesn't notice the ruins around him.

choices.text: Play along. "A friend of the kingdom."
Tell him the truth — the kingdom is gone.

play_along.text: "Pass, friend. Watch for the goblin scouts to the east." He stands aside, rigid and proud. You walk through him without resistance.

truth.text: His expression fractures. "The kingdom is... gone?" He looks at his hands — through them. "How long?" He weeps, and then fades.

dismiss.text: "Be at peace, soldier. Your watch is over. The kingdom endures in better forms." He straightens. Salutes. Dissolves.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You can see me.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: He's still out there. The man who did this. He walks free in Thornwall, selling grain and waving to neighbors.

choices.text: Offer to pass her message to the magistrate.

name.text: "Hessler. Hessler the miller." She burns with cold fury. "Remember it." You will.

message.text: "They won't listen. They never do. But... thank you for trying." She hands you her ring — evidence. "Maybe you'll have better luck."

leave.text: She watches you walk away. The cold follows you for three miles.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Don't go that way. The bad thing lives that way.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A child — transparent, cold, no older than eight. She points down the left fork.

choices.text: Trust her. Take the right fork.
Ask what the bad thing is.

trust.text: The right fork is longer but safe. In the distance, you hear sounds from the left path — something large and angry. She was right.

ask.text: "Teeth that don't stop. And eyes. Too many eyes." She won't say more. She fades when you press her.

left.text: You find what she meant. It finds you first. You survive, barely, and take the right fork going back.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I built this fortress. Every stone. Forty years of work.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: And then they told me what it was really for.

choices.text: "What did you do when you found out?"

ask.text: "A Veil anchor. The whole structure channels Veil energy upward. It's why I can't leave. It's why I won't leave — if I go, the anchor stabilizes fully."

passages.text: He brightens. "Twelve. Here, here, and here—" He traces the walls with a ghostly finger. You memorize every route.

did.text: "I kept building. I didn't know how to stop. There's a kind of courage in stopping." He looks down at his transparent hands. "I never learned it in time."

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: Hundreds of spirits, moving in unison, singing a single sustained note. The harmony is perfect. The sound makes your ribs ache.

listen.text: The song is grief and defiance together. Every spirit here died fighting the Veil. They're still fighting — with this song. Something in you aligns with it.

understand.text: A resonance ward — they keep the Veil from spreading further by anchoring the border with collective will. They cannot leave. But while they sing, nothing from the Veil can cross here.

pass.text: The choir parts around you like water. Each face you see looks at peace and terrible in equal measure. You emerge on the other side, inexplicably steadied.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I left the militia three days ago. I know that makes me a criminal. But they were marching us into the Veil-touched zone and calling it a "cleansing operation."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I didn't sign up to be fed to it.

choices.text: Let him pass. His fear is valid.
Report him to the next garrison.
[INT 10] Ask what he knows about the militia's plans.

let_pass.text: He nods, grateful and haunted. "Thank you." He melts into the undergrowth.

report.text: You give the garrison his description. They pay a small reward. Whether they catch him, you don't know.

intel.text: He tells you everything — patrol routes, commander weaknesses, supply depots. A deserter with a grudge is a considerable intelligence asset.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I ran the Ironhand crew for six years. A hundred people worked for me. I was very good at a very bad thing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Then the Veil took my crew. Every last one. I'm the only survivor. Tell me what to do with that.

choices.text: "Use those skills for something worth using them for."
"There's nothing to do with that. Carry it and move."
[STR 12] "Start by putting down anyone who comes after you."

redirect.text: "Skills worth something." She looks at her hands. "Yeah. Maybe. I know every supply route in the region." She joins your cause.

carry.text: She nods slowly. "Honest." She hands you half her provisions. "I travel lighter than I used to."

fight.text: "That I know how to do." A dark smile. "Someone's always coming after you in my trade. Nice to have company in it."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ten gold. Per person. For the safety this road has thanks to us.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Don't think of it as robbery. Think of it as... infrastructure.

choices.text: [INT 12] Expose the extortion to the local militia.
"I'd like to see you try collecting."

pay.text: He pockets it with a practiced smile. "Smart traveler. Safe roads ahead." They step aside.

expose.text: You memorize their faces and post descriptions at the next garrison. Three days later, you hear the militia cleaned this road out.

fight_back.text: "Oh, a difficult one." He signals. Four others step from the trees. You negotiate with violence. They don't take the toll. They don't have teeth to count it with.

threaten.text: "Feisty! But we've got four bows on you." He smiles. "Let's try again. Ten gold."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A militia payroll wagon. Two guards, one driver, forty thousand gold pieces.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I've got the route. I need the muscle. Half and half — nobody gets hurt if they're smart about it.

choices.text: Decline. This isn't your kind of work.
[INT 14] Counter-propose: inform the militia for a reward.

agree.text: The job goes smooth. Nobody gets hurt. You walk away with gold and a reputation you didn't ask for.

decline.text: "Your loss." She fades into an alley. The wagon passes unmolested. Probably.

inform.text: You sell the route to the militia commander. They set an ambush. The payout is generous. Korve doesn't know it was you. Yet.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I'm done. Thirty years of this, and I'm done. Last job is just this one thing — then I'm gone west where the Veil hasn't touched.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I need your help. Nothing violent. Just a distraction.

choices.text: Wish him luck but stay clear.
[DEX 12] Offer to do the actual theft — you're quicker.

help.text: Your distraction works perfectly. He gets what he came for. He presses half the take into your hands without a word and disappears west.

decline.text: "Fair enough. Can't blame you." He tips his hat and walks toward his fate alone.

take_over.text: You move faster and cleaner than he could. He watches with professional respect. "Kid like you shouldn't be wasting time on the straight road." He splits the take three ways — including your skill bonus.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A rough stone shrine with a flame that doesn't go out despite the wind. An offering bowl holds old coins.

choices.text: Take the old coins from the bowl.

offer.text: The flame grows briefly brighter and warm in a way that has nothing to do with heat. Something approves. You carry a warmth in your chest that lasts a day.

steal.text: Eight copper coins. And a burn on your palm that won't heal for three days. Some offerings are watched.

pray.text: The flame doesn't judge. It gives what you put into it — which is nothing and nothing back. But you feel heard.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: A shrine so covered in growth that only the silhouette of a figure is visible. The name on the base has been worn completely smooth.

choices.text: Clear the vines and restore it.

restore.text: You clear the growth and the figure emerges — a god of travelers. As you step back, you feel the road a little lighter under your feet.

identify.text: Vaerith, god of crossroads — declared heretical and unmade by the Third King's priests. Still here, quietly. "Still here," you say to the stone. The wind replies.

leave.text: Some things are forgotten for a reason. Or perhaps no reason at all. It's hard to know from the outside.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.text: The altar is recent. The offering is recent. Whatever was given here, it was not coin.

choices.text: Leave it. This is not your affair.

destroy.text: The altar cracks under your heel. A shriek from somewhere below you. The air tastes of ash and relief.

identify.text: The sigils belong to the Veil Sovereign's intermediaries — a mid-tier cult cell. They're active here. You note the location.

leave.text: You walk on. That night you wonder if that was the right call. The wondering doesn't stop.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I've been praying at this shrine for six hours. The god still hasn't answered.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Perhaps it needs a different voice.

choices.text: Gods answer in their own time. Or not at all.

join.text: Two voices. The shrine's flame steadies. It doesn't speak, but something about the road ahead feels known. The priest wipes tears he didn't expect to shed.

advise.text: "An offering of action, not words?" He considers. He does something — you don't watch — and the shrine answers. He shares the blessing with you.

leave.text: "You may be right," he says quietly. "But I'd rather keep trying."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The Veil is not evil. It is honest. It shows you what you are when everything else is stripped away.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I worship what is true. Most people find that disturbing.

choices.text: "Truth and evil are not mutually exclusive."

argue.text: "Ah. A pragmatist." He smiles. "Yes. But at least the Veil doesn't lie about it." You find you have no answer to that.

ask.text: He is quiet for a long time. "It showed me that I am very small, and that small things can still matter enormously." He hands you a veil-touched amulet.

debate.text: The argument is long, sharp, and largely honest. Neither of you wins. Both of you learn something. He donates his rations to you, "for arguing in good faith."

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I can't find my flock. I was watching them and then the fog came and—

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My mum's going to be so angry. She's always angry when the flock scatters.

choices.text: Walk him home first, then search.
[INT 10] Use the sheep's tracks to find the flock quickly.

help.text: An hour of searching. Twelve sheep behind a hedge, calm as furniture. Tam hugs the lead sheep. His mum isn't angry — she was worried about him.

home_first.text: His mother bursts out crying the moment she sees him. She finds the flock herself by noon. She presses warm bread into your hands.

track.text: You follow the prints to a hollow where all twelve sheep are dozing. Tam is so relieved he gives you his lunch.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I've been gathering in this forest for fifty years. And somehow today I am completely lost.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My basket is full and my knees hurt and I would very much like to go home.

choices.text: Escort her out of the forest.
[INT 10] Navigate by the moss and sun.

escort.text: An hour of slow walking and her stories about every plant you pass. At the forest edge, she identifies three of your herbs as actually mislabeled — then fixes them. Better than any herbalist.

navigate.text: You orient by shadow and moss growth. She follows, impressed. "Sharp eyes. Here — this corrects inflammation. I have plenty."

directions.text: She listens carefully, nods, and heads off. You hear her humming. She'll probably be fine.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: My unit was ambushed. I ran. I'm not proud of that — I ran.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I don't know if anyone else made it. I don't know where I am.

choices.text: Give him your map and send him north.
[INT 12] Use his patrol route to find survivors.

help.text: You find two others from his unit, alive and hidden. The reunion is wordless — the kind that doesn't need words.

map.text: He takes it with shaking hands. "Thank you. I'll—" He catches himself. "Thank you." He goes north.

survivors.text: His patrol route maps to two known survival points. You find three soldiers, not two. All alive.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I was following my master and got distracted by a very interesting fungal formation and now I can't find him at all.
